findings.title: Correct the observer export name
findings.body: The manifest selects the `observe` export; `watch` is the observer registration ID. As written, the guide tells readers inspecting or adapting this fixture that the wrong exported handler name is selected, which can lead to a failed activation when copied into a package.

overall_explanation: The bounded observer recipe is otherwise aligned with the supplied fixture and runtime journey, but it misidentifies the selected handler export.
